title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・自分を生きてこそ

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeahhhhh! Did ya see that?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: What a magnificent show from Vodka! Reckless and unique! Truly striking!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: That's Vodka for you! This Umamusume has remained steadfast in pursuing her own path and has finally reached the top!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… Trainer! You've got somethin' to say to me, don't ya?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Don't ya?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You're damn right I am! I've done it! I've become the coolest Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And you're the one who got me here! Hell yeahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We hug each other so tightly that I can almost hear ribs cracking over our shouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's supposed to be cool, but right now, she's burning hot enough to set the Tokyo turf on fire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then… the awards ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sup, it's Vodka! …Well, all of Japan probably knows that by now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I won today! But winning isn't all I did. Two important things happened today.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What's she being so condescending for?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: First, I beat Daiwa Scarlet and took the Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's just not the same if I win when she's not running. That's because…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Scarlet's the number one Umamusume! It's because of her I could shine so brightly today.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wh-what are you doing? Don't bring me into this, you d-dummy!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And the other important thing: I was able to win today because I kept doin' things my own way!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: After all, that's the only way I know how to do things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka reflects back on a few of the races she's run…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Stayin' true to yourself isn't always so easy. Sometimes ya break. Sometimes you're crushed.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sometimes changin' yourself is an easy way to get stronger. But…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's just boring! You need someone ya wanna challenge even if winnin' seems impossible!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And sometimes you do beat 'em! Ya might lose, but you might also win. And, you know what?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Winnin' that way is the absolute coolest! Take it from me! I'm livin' proof!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: There might be Umamusume out there who're stronger than me, but I'm the coolest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Heh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Follow my lead, everyone! Don't give up on yourselves! Laugh when things are tough!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I can't say what'll happen for sure. But!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I can say that if ya live your own way, someone'll always be there to cheer ya on.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You gotta grab glory together with them! …Come on up here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I wanna introduce ya guys to my partner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yeaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's up with those two? They look so happy…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Whatever! Ugh, I'm done with this! Dummy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka pulls me up, puts her arm around my shoulder, and gives me a big smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The ultimate sense of accomplishment that comes with reaching the end of an uncharted road—that's what Vodka obtained today.
